metadata.goal: Add runnable Web-IDE demos for the flow-control statements implemented in spl-flow, including multi-column (indented block) execution and E2E smoke coverage.

phase.name: Spec & Design Lock
phase.description: Lock the demo scope, multi-column execution approach, and test strategy.

tasks.task:
Draft and confirm the track docs.
codument/tracks/add-web-ide-flow-control-demos/spec.md codument/tracks/add-web-ide-flow-control-demos/proposal.md codument/tracks/add-web-ide-flow-control-demos/design.md

phase.name: Web-IDE Multi-Column Execution
phase.description: Make Run Sheet collect multi-column cells so indentation blocks can run.

tasks.task:
Upgrade the Web-IDE Run Sheet logic from A-only to collecting a bounded grid region (e.g. 20x8 A..H) of non-empty cells.
packages/web-ide/src/pages/SplIde.vue
Run Sheet sends non-empty cells from multiple columns (A..H) as {row,col,expr}[] to backend. Existing A-only demos still run unchanged.

phase.name: Flow-Control Demos
phase.description: Add separate runnable demos for each flow-control statement/scenario, each producing a visible summary table output.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Demo runs and output table indicates the taken branch.

subtask.name: Write demo grid (one cell per row)

tasks.task:
Demos: infinite / count / range(step) / sequence / while + #<cellRef>.
Each demo runs and outputs the expected aggregate (sum/count/iteration info).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Nested loop demos validate break/continue (with target) behavior via output table.
Demo shows skipped cells do not affect output.
Demo shows subroutine call result in output table.
Demo captures an error string and continues; output table includes the message.
result demo terminates early and preserves pre-result output.
end demo shows an error status in the UI.
